name: beeCount
meaning: Scenaric_FindByClass(107 Bees, bees, 5) result; loop bound for msg 0x67

name: homePos
meaning: = pos at Init and on msg 9 arg 1; msg 0x55 moves the pot back here

name: spillBox
meaning: query box rebuilt around the pot (x/z +-150, y from pos-150 to pos); min +0x94, max +0x9a; flags word +0x90 never written. Used by Update state 4 (ObjGrid_QueryBoxOverlap for Sam) and msg 2 (Sam origin test)

name: bees
meaning: Bees objects (class 107) that receive msg 0x67 (arg Sam) while Sam stands in the spill

name: hiveMother
meaning: PROPERTY_HONEYPOT_HIVEMOTHER (Scn_GetPropObject offset 0); also gets msg 0x67; not NULL-checked

name: sam
meaning: Sam (Scenaric_FindByClass(1)); his origin is tested in msg 2

name: launchSoundHandle
meaning: Sound_Play(0xA6) handle on msg 0xC; zeroed by Init/Reset, never read or stopped

name: landSoundHandle
meaning: Sound_Play(0xA7) handle on msg 0x25; zeroed by Init/Reset, never read or stopped
